description.en: This plugin adds native Office editors to DeepSeek Harness. You and your AI agent can edit Word documents, Excel workbooks, and PowerPoint slide decks and review changes in place.
description.zh: 这款插件给 DeepSeek Harness 装上原生 Office 编辑器。你可以与 AI 在同一份文件里编辑 Word 文稿、Excel 表格和 PowerPoint 幻灯片，在原位置核对修改。
